OSC unit container conformance vectors, copied unchanged (README.md omitted) from
aien-dev/aien-protocols PR #17, specs/osc-unit-artifact/{vectors,keys}, head e6669cc (adds r49 to r51 and a06, the declared-limit bound vectors)
(contract OSC_UNIT_ARTIFACT.md, container version 1, frozen v1).
Both keys are THROWAWAY TEST keys derived from fixed labels in that spec's
tools/make-vectors.sh. They protect nothing and must never enter a real anchor set.
launch.txt (launch code 41) is vectors/launch.txt, used by tests/test_osc_launch.c (C3-3a).

launch/ (added by the C3-3a task-launch cut):
  osc-launch-check.c  copied unchanged from the same spec (tools/osc-launch-check.c): the C reference
                      for the launch-argument rule (spec 9.2, launch code 41). vectors/launch.txt is the
                      spec's launch.txt, unchanged.
  l01.S, make-l01.sh, l01_launch_fns.unit, l01.code
                      a TEST-signed unit (the spec's throwaway key test1, built with the spec's own
                      generator helpers) of hand-assembled functions: trap, spin, peek0, poke_rt,
                      bare_brk, exec_stack, overflow, counter. NOT compiled by oscc; its IR section is
                      min.ir, so the IR does not describe the code (attested, never checked: spec 10).
                      Fixture for the QEMU launch gate only.
